# R8 Mock browser suite follows the redesigned app

Scope: the 24 tests of `npx playwright test` (mock-adapter suite, CI job `e2e`) that fail because they assert the previous design. Test code only. Baseline: 24 failed, 30 passed.

Facts: the suite runs `NEXT_PUBLIC_ADAPTERS=mock npx next dev`; mock adapters never fetch. `playwright.config.ts` ignores `real-*.spec.ts`. The app shell root is `.kv-app`; theme in `src/styles/app-theme.css`. Under 1024px a `ViewportGate` replaces the app. `/` and `/signin` both render `SignIn`; in mock mode it shows the phone / email form.

## R8.1 Changes

First run the suite once and save the failing list to `"${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/mock-e2e-before.txt"`.

1. `playwright.config.ts`: the port comes from `process.env.KV_E2E_PORT ?? "3201"` in `baseURL`, the `next dev -p` command and `url`; `reuseExistingServer` becomes `false`. Nothing else changes.
2. Journey tests keep their titles and still walk the whole journey through the current screens: `chat.spec.ts` "hospital list renders for a seeded pincode"; `covers.spec.ts` "add a cover, pick the plan, confirm, review facts and settle a conflict"; `journey.spec.ts` "profile, one schedule PDF, go-ahead, clause question with citation"; `walkthrough.spec.ts` "keyboard only: / to /signin to /welcome to /home to /emergency" (the root path now renders the sign-in screen itself). Selectors are read from the rendered components; role and name selectors preferred.
3. `e2e/signin-showcase.spec.ts` is deleted: the showcase lanes no longer exist.
4. `e2e/mobile-targets.spec.ts`: both failing tests are deleted (the app is laptop only); the file is deleted if it is then empty. One test is added to `t8-shell.spec.ts`: `under 1024px the app shows the open on a laptop screen`, asserting what the gate renders at 390x800 on `/home`.
5. `t8-shell.spec.ts`: E1 becomes `E1 subtabs shown at 1280 on a page that has them`. E2 and E8 (390px) are deleted; the gate test replaces them. E5 becomes `E5 ask bar hidden on chat` when the code hides it there; otherwise it asserts what the code does and is named for that. E6 becomes `E6 ask bar geometry` (inside the page column, not overlapping the rail). E7 and E9 keep their titles and are rewritten against the current shell (five-place rail, sub-tabs row, ask bar fixed under the page, no floating Ask button).
6. `t10-motion.spec.ts`: "landing headline and reveals" and "signin lanes marquee 48s and pause off-screen" are deleted (removed features). "tools tab and signin filter swap use Mercury values" and "ask panel dimmer and panel values" are rewritten to assert only what exists now, reading durations from the custom properties `--t-in`, `--t-out`, `--t-press`, `--t-panel` on `.kv-app`, not literals. Nothing is asserted about the absence of animation on page load, or about hover and press transforms (task R7 adds those).
7. `t2-load.spec.ts` "no remount", "one stage", "no text swap", "budget": titles kept, selectors and expectations follow the current Home markup, intent kept. A numeric budget rises only by what a measured run shows is needed; old and new numbers are reported.

## R8.2 Out of scope

Any `src/` change, `e2e/real-*`, unit tests, CI workflow files, new dependencies.
